name: Miyasaka Rikuto
source:
A male student who had gone on to higher education and was living in an apartment, but was evicted because of the earthquake-proof disguise problem, and was in need of a place to live.

He is introduced to a shared house by his cousin Ayami, who works for a housing management company, and moves in as an “acting caretaker.

He is now of average build, but as a child he was sickly and weak, and he longs to be “masculine” and “strong. Perhaps because of his childhood, he enjoys reading books. He is a member of the library committee because of his love of reading.

He is sincere and earnest, but has a timid nature and is not good at socializing. He is not immune to the opposite sex, and gets nervous in front of people of the opposite sex. He hopes to improve this situation by living together with others.

[From [url=http://www.ordin-soft.com/bitchhouse.html]official site[/url]]
